plan_section: §7.1 universe/pair fit + §10 anchored folds + §15 stage machine
contract: Fixed 12-symbol universe. Per fold, cointegration fit uses ONLY the last 60d of train (plan fit_lookback_days option). Selection by stationarity/stability (ADF t<-2.85, half-life<168h), NEVER by strategy return. Each fold commits train_selection_commit_sha256 BEFORE any validation read.
fit_window_rationale: Full-train OLS cointegration over multi-year crypto windows is dominated by structural bull/bear trends and shows NO stationarity (verified: all 66 pairs adf_t>-2 over full train). The plan's explicit fit_lookback_days∈{30,60,120} options anticipate this; we use the last 60d of train, the most recent train info before the purge boundary.

F1.reason: 2023 H1 train window (crypto bull-cycle onset) yields only 1 train-stable disjoint pair at ADF 5%; plan §7.1 requires >=3. This fold's M1 search is blocked but does NOT block other folds.

conclusion: R4 DATA/FOLD/GROUP-FIT FREEZE PASSED for F2/F3/F4 (3 of 4 folds). F1 is blocked_no_stable_groups (honest empirical result: 2023-H1 has insufficient cointegration). The M1 synchronized pair search proceeds on F2/F3/F4 with frozen train-only fits. Each frozen fit carries a fit_sha256 and the fold carries a train_selection_commit_sha256 committed before validation.
